description: Get single batch details by uniqueName: stock/variant, mfg/expiry, days remaining,. Part of the All APIs in Giddh. Requires Auth-Key or Session-Id.

q.description: Search text (case sensitivity depends on the endpoint). Optional.

count.description: Page size (number of items returned). Optional.

sortBy.description: Field name to sort by. Default: createdAt. Optional.

sort.description: Sort direction. Allowed values: asc, desc. Default: desc. Optional.

branchUniqueName.description: Branch uniqueName; omit for default company branch behaviour. Optional.
